job: Wait a few seconds before an action goes, with a countdown and Undo.
purpose: A strip with a ring that drains with the time left, the action in words, a note that nothing has happened yet, and Undo. A commit with data-fd-hold or a button with data-fd-hold-for starts it; focus moves to Undo. Undo or Escape stops it and returns focus; the end fires fd:commit. Leaving the page sends it. Screen readers hear the start and the undo. toast.hold draws the same ring in a toast.
useWhen: Sending is hard to take back: money, access, a message, a shipped change, a cancelled run.
A person commits in one press and deserves a moment to change their mind.

avoidWhen.when: It is already done and the server can reverse it.
A mistake destroys history and must not happen by one press.
Work that runs for minutes with progress to watch.

states.name: running
states.how: data-state="running" while it counts; the trigger is disabled

states.name: idle
states.how: hidden until a hold starts, and again once it is undone or sent

variants.useWhen: The held action removes or stops something; a danger commit button sets it.
The length of a hold started by data-fd-hold-for; 10 by default, 5 inside a dialog.

parts.role: The countdown ring; data-size="sm" in a toast.
The whole seconds left, inside the ring.
The action in progress: "Approving the credit".

keyboard.does: Stops the hold when focus is in it, in its form, or nowhere.
On Undo: stops the hold and returns focus to the button that started it.
